optional_typography.excerpt: [F1] Word balls have upper and lower bounds by positive multiples of n^D for all sufficiently large n. … the fiber contains at most a constant times n^cr elements. There are at most a constant times n^{D-cr} quotient fibers. Multiplication gives the upper n^D bound.
optional_typography.symptom: Several inline growth exponents are written as plain ASCII caret notation outside math delimiters and render literally (including n^D, n^cr, and n^{D-cr}).
optional_typography.suggested_repair: Wrap the inline growth expressions in MathMarkdown, keeping exponent scope explicit.

review_summary.notes: All 97 source and snapshot SHA256 values equal the frozen assignment hash; all HTML SHA256 values equal the frozen assignment HTML hash. Every tile was individually opened using original resolution. The black background and lowercase item-id breadcrumb are part of the supplied audit render.
